newsitem.title: RUSSIA: RUSSIAN YAMALO-NENETS PLANS $100-150 MLN '97 BOND.
newsitem.headline: RUSSIAN YAMALO-NENETS PLANS $100-150 MLN '97 BOND.

text.p: Yamalo-Nenets autonomous region, located in Russia's Far North, said on Thursday it planned a Eurobond issue of between $100 and $150 million by the end of the year.

"The volume will depend on which programmes we decide will be financed by the borrowing, but now we plan on between $100 and $150 million," local administration Finance Department Head Alexander Matveyev told Reuters.
Matveyev said Yamalo-Nenetsky region would carry out a tender for a lead-manager by the end of August and would make the issue by the end of the year.
Russia's Natsionalny Rezervny Bank, which is closely linked to Gazprom natural gas monopoly, is the region's financial adviser on the issue, he said.

Matveyev said the region contained most of Russia's gas reserves and it was one of the rare regions which does not get financial help from the federal budget. He said the region also planned to issue a domestic bond worth 1.5 trillion roubles ($260 billion) in August or September this year.
The region joins a long queue of Russian regions and cities planning Eurobond issues. ($ = 5,807 roubles)
